what: While the two-section mint panel scrolls, once the top edge of the second section (marker) rises above the 250px line from the top of the screen, the panel background changes to another color (gray) over .5s ease, and returns when scrolled back below the line — the spot where color divides the sections as the lesson panel sliding up over the video moves from ”Studio” to ”Online”

options.offset: Switches when the marker’s top edge comes this far (px) in from the top of the screen, default 250
options.[data-fx-part=marker]: Section that serves as the swap reference (child inside the panel, required)
options.--fx-to: Changed background color (css), default gray mixed with 31% of the text color

use:
First page
Second Section

from.where: index.html .mm-lessons (original .l_wrap — scroll > .lesson_o.offset().top − 250 then .bk, background-color var(--gn2) → var(--gy2), transition all .5s)
